reviews.title: Options on the app
reviews.text: I think it’s bad that you can pick what drinks you have had that day since it’s an app to encourage drinking more water I don’t drink coffe so it gives me limited options of what I can actually say I have drunk which then would be a lie if I didn’t put anything if I had a glass of juice. I know it’s for the apps side of getting more money however it doesn’t make sense how I can log what I actually drank that day so this is for the creators to maybe make changes to the app

reviews.title: A bit pointless
reviews.text: Based on my accurate parameters it has decided I only need to drink 1.1L a day. That’s rubbish and not healthy

reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: I thought it would be free on what different drinks there are but it isn’t

reviews.title: Payment
reviews.text: Whilst I appreate why apps need you to pay being able to select a top 5 or so drinks for free would be more valuable than the preselected 3 as I wanted to use this app to generally track my intake (includ in soda and alcohol) and I don’t drink coffee and tea which made this app unusable for me without payment.
